subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90-
guide_solution: Summary The international Mother Language Day is being observed every year since February 2000. It helps to promote linguistic, cultural diversity and multilingualism. It is a significant day in our national history. On the day 21 february in 1952 the streets of Dhaka university was strained with the blood of Barkat, Rafique, Salam, Jabbar and others. The UNESCO has proclaimed February 21st as the International Mother Language Day to be observed globally in recognition of the sacrifices of the martyrs.
